# Business Santa

> Business Santa, powered by SEO Season (https://seoseason.com, the SEO platform built by Manav S), is an SEO and GEO (AI search) service for US businesses, founded by Manav S. The team (Jyoti, Manav, Sam and Sakshi) does technical SEO, on-page SEO, Google Search Console fixes, WordPress and Yoast SEO, Shopify e-commerce SEO, monthly SEO, and visibility in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Claude and Gemini.

- Founder: Manav S, 10+ years in SEO, 2,000+ projects delivered, 4.9 average rating from 2,000+ client reviews
- Starting prices: On-Page SEO from $120, Technical SEO from $160. Monthly, Shopify, GEO and full packages are quoted after a free site review.
- Platforms: WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, custom sites.
- Free check: request it on WhatsApp or by email at https://businesssanta.com/#check
- Full services and prices: https://seoseason.com/businesssanta
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/businesssanta
- Human-led: every change is done or reviewed by a person; client logins and private data are never put into public AI chat tools.
- Policy: no guaranteed rankings; every change is reported and verifiable in Google Search Console.
